name: skills-for-claude
description: Skills that make agents earn their claims: receipts before completion, prior art before building.

plugins.name: vouch
plugins.description: Receipts, not recall: claim guard, grounding lock, loop monitor, per-model bankroll and autonomy tiers. Zero model calls on the happy path.

plugins.name: dejavu
plugins.description: Has anyone done this before? Tiered search of GitHub, registries, discussion sites, papers and the web before you build; a report with a verdict, closest matches and a falsifiable search log; offered automatically in plan mode and gated at ExitPlanMode until you answer.
